arxiv-2204-10699.title: The subharmonic bifurcation of Stokes waves on vorticity flow
arxiv-2204-10699.creator: Vladimir Kozlov 1
arxiv-2204-10699.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Vladimir Kozlov 1. Untill 1980 1980 one of the main subjects of study in the theory of nonlinear water waves were the Stokes and solitary waves (regular waves). To that time small amplitude regular waves were constructed and the existence of large amplitude water waves of the same type was proved by using branches of water waves starting from a trivial (horizontal) wave and ending at extreme waves.

arxiv-2205-10416.title: ARLO: A Framework for Automated Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2205-10416.creator: Marco Mussi, Davide Lombarda, Alberto Maria Metelli, Francesco Trovò, Marcello Restelli
arxiv-2205-10416.description: Abstract Automated Reinforcement Learning (AutoRL) is a relatively new area of research that is gaining increasing attention. The objective of AutoRL consists in easing the employment of Reinforcement Learning (RL) techniques for the broader public by alleviating some of its main challenges, including data collection, algorithm selection, and hyper-parameter tuning.

arxiv-2205-11684.title: Desirable Rankings: A New Method for Ranking Outcomes of a Competitive Process Emails: tsmorril@ncsu.edu and troyan@virginia.edu. We are grateful to Kyle Woodward who helped us start this project and contributed many thoughtful ideas. Thayer would like to thank the Stanford market design coffee grou
arxiv-2205-11684.creator: Thayer Morrill, Peter Troyan
arxiv-2205-11684.description: Abstract We consider the problem of aggregating individual preferences over alternatives into a social ranking. A key feature of the problems that we consider—and the one that allows us to obtain positive results, in contrast to negative results such as Arrow’s Impossibililty Theorem—is that the alternatives to be ranked are outcomes of a competitive process.

arxiv-2208-14619.title: Accelerating differential evolution algorithm with Gaussian sampling based on estimating the convergence points
arxiv-2208-14619.creator: 1 st Rui Zhong, 2 nd Masaharu Munetomo
arxiv-2208-14619.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a simple strategy for estimating the convergence point approximately by averaging the elite sub-population. Based on this idea, we derive two methods, which are ordinary averaging strategy, and weighted averaging strategy. We also design a Gaussian sampling operator with the mean of the estimated convergence point with a certain standard deviation.

arxiv-2401-13998.title: WAL-Net: Weakly supervised auxiliary task learning network for carotid plaques classification
arxiv-2401-13998.creator: Haitao Gan, Lingchao Fu, Ran Zhou, Weiyan Gan, Furong Wang, Xiaoyan Wu, Zhi Yang, Zhongwei Huang
arxiv-2401-13998.description: Abstract The classification of carotid artery ultrasound images is a crucial means for diagnosing carotid plaques, holding significant clinical relevance for predicting the risk of stroke. Recent research suggests that utilizing plaque segmentation as an auxiliary task for classification can enhance performance by leveraging the correlation between segmentation and classification tasks.

arxiv-2406-12125.title: Efficient Sequential Decision Making with Large Language Models
arxiv-2406-12125.creator: Dingyang Chen ⋆, Qi Zhang ⋆, Yinglun Zhu †
arxiv-2406-12125.description: Abstract This paper focuses on extending the success of large language models (LLMs) to sequential decision making. Existing efforts either (i) re-train or finetune LLMs for decision making, or (ii) design prompts for pretrained LLMs. The former approach suffers from the computational burden of gradient updates, and the latter approach does not show promising results.

arxiv-2410-06341.title: Open-Source Parametric Airfoils to Study Geometric Effects on Buffet
arxiv-2410-06341.creator: Zauner M, Lusher D. J, Moise P, Sansica A, Hashimoto A, Sandham N. D
arxiv-2410-06341.description: Abstract Recent research into buffet in the transonic flow regime has been focused on a limited number of proprietary airfoil geometries and has mainly considered parametric variations in Mach number and angle of attack. In contrast, relatively little is known about the sensitivity of buffet frequencies and amplitudes to geometric properties of airfoils.

arxiv-2503-18570.title: Dense Retrieval for Low Resource languages - the Case of Amharic Language
arxiv-2503-18570.creator: Tilahun Yeshambel, Moncef Garouani, Serge Molina, Josiane Mothe
arxiv-2503-18570.description: Abstract This paper reports some difficulties and some results when using dense retrievers on Amharic, one of the low-resource languages spoken by 120 millions populations. The efforts put and difficulties faced by Univ. Addis Ababa Univ. toward Amharic Information Retrieval will be developed during the presentation.

arxiv-2509-22029.title: Initial boundary value problems for 3-d Navier-Stokes equations with hyperbolic heat conduction Thanks: Yuxi Hu, Department of Mathematics, China University of Mining and Technology, Beijing, 100083, P.R. China, yxhu86@163.com Reinhard Racke, Department of Mathematics and Statistics, University of K
arxiv-2509-22029.creator: Yuxi Hu and Reinhard Racke
arxiv-2509-22029.description: Abstract . We study an initial boundary value problem for the 3-dimensional compressible Navier-Stokes equations with hyperbolic heat conduction, where the classical Fourier law is replaced by the Cattaneo-Christov constitutive relation. We focus on spherically symmetric solutions. We establish the existence of uniform global small solutions to the resulting system.

arxiv-2512-07222.title: Pay Less Attention to Function Words for Free Robustness of Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2512-07222.creator: Qiwei Tian, Chenhao Lin, Zhengyu Zhao, Chao Shen
arxiv-2512-07222.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Qiwei Tian, Chenhao Lin, Zhengyu Zhao, Chao Shen. To address the trade-off between robustness and performance for robust VLM, we observe that function words could incur vulnerability of VLMs against cross-modal adversarial attacks, and propose Function-word De-Attention (FDA) accordingly to mitigate the impact of function words. Similar to differential amplifiers, our FDA calculates the original and the function-word cross-attention within attention heads, and differentially subtracts the latter from the former for more aligned and robust VLMs.

europmc-pmc2629778.creator: Corander J, Marttinen P, Sirén J, Tang J.

pmc-11297985.title: Impact of Bi2O3 on prepared nano (SiO2-Na2O-CaO-B2O3) glass as radiation shielding material
pmc-11297985.creator: A. S. Doma, Mahmoud I. Abbas, Abd El Hady B. Kashyout, Ebrahim A. Mahdy, Eman A. Ghafeir, Mirvat Fawzi Dib, Hala Abdellatif, Ahmed M. El-Khatib
pmc-11297985.description: Melt quenching technique was used to create Bismuth Boro-Silicate nano glasses with compositions of 45SiO2-10CaO- 25Na2O- xBi2O3- (20-x) B2O3 (where x is 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20 mol %). Standard point sources AM-241, Ba-133, Co-60, Cs-137, and Eu-152 were used in the radiation experiment to evaluate the attenuation coefficients spanning the energy range of 59.51 keV to 1048.01 keV.

pmc-11496823.title: Seabird nutrients increase coral calcification rates and boost reef carbonate production
pmc-11496823.creator: Ines D Lange, Cassandra E Benkwitt
pmc-11496823.description: While excessive anthropogenic nutrient loads are harmful to coral reefs, natural nutrient flows can boost coral growth and reef functions. Here we investigate if seabird-derived nutrient subsidies benefit the growth of two dominant corals on lagoonal reefs, submassive Isopora palifera and corymbose Acropora vermiculata, and if enhanced colony-level calcification rates can increase reef-scale carbonate production. pmc-11647896.title: Biomolecule and Ion Releasing Mesoporous Nanoparticles: Nonconvergent Osteogenic and Osteo-immunogenic Performance
pmc-11647896.creator: Azin Khodaei, Qaisar Nawaz, Zhengqing Zhu, Saber Amin Yavari, Harrie Weinans, Aldo R Boccaccini
pmc-11647896.description: Immune-involved cell communications have recently been introduced as key role players in the fate of mesenchymal stem cells in making bone tissue. In this study, a drug delivery system for bone (re)generation based on copper-doped mesoporous bioactive glass nanoparticles (BGNPs) was developed to codeliver copper as a biologically active ion and icariin as an anti-inflammatory agent.

pmc-12373309.title: O “esquecimento global” e os eventos comunicativos extremos
pmc-12373309.creator: Paulo Roberto Vasconcellos-Silva, Luís David Castiel
pmc-12373309.description: Resumo:No presente ensaio, são descritas as evidências científicas voltadas ao decaimento da memória e do foco pelo hiperestímulo das mídias digitais - aqui apelidado de “esquecimento global”. Argumenta-se que este não se resume a aspectos unicamente psiconeurológicos individuais, mas a processos socioculturais contemporâneos constituídos e alimentados por vetores técnicos, políticos e econômicos convergentes.

pmc-12428890.title: Comparison of Open Versus Minimally Invasive Repair of Colovesical Fistula: A Case Report and Propensity-Matched National Database Analysis
pmc-12428890.creator: Alexis Volkert, Anmol Nigam, David Stover, Pravin Meshram, Rubeena Naaz, Chidiebere Onongaya, Sean Huu-Tien Nguyen, Jordan Sauve, Wolfgang Gaertner, James V. Harmon Jr.
pmc-12428890.description: Background: Colovesical fistulas are abnormal communications between the colon and urinary bladder, most commonly caused by diverticular disease. Although colovesical fistulas are rare, they should be suspected in patients presenting with recurrent urinary tract infections, pneumaturia, or fecaluria. We integrated two case reports with a retrospective national cohort analysis to assess the surgical treatment of colovesical fistulas.

pmc-12565573.title: DNA Damage and Bisphenol Levels in Chronic Kidney Disease Patients Undergoing Hemodialysis
pmc-12565573.creator: Cesar Emilio Ruiz, Lourdes Vela, Martí Nadal, Neus González, Ricard Marcos, Alba Hernández, Susana Pastor, Elisabeth Coll, Noureddine Bouaïcha
pmc-12565573.description: Bisphenol (BP) compounds are widely present in the environment, primarily due to their use as plastic additives. These substances involve health risks, particularly as endocrine disruptors. While the general population is chronically exposed, patients with end-stage chronic kidney disease undergoing hemodialysis (HD-CKD) represent a particularly vulnerable group.

pmc-13103305.title: MultiScaleWave: a wavelet-based multiscale framework for univariate time series forecasting
pmc-13103305.creator: Canjie Zheng, Heng Zhao
pmc-13103305.description: Accurate forecasting of time series data is essential in many fields. However, real-world time series are often characterized by noise, non-stationarity and multiscale temporal dependencies, which collectively reduce forecasting performance. To address these challenges, MultiScaleWave, a deep learning framework based on time series decomposition, is proposed for univariate forecasting.

pmc-13355627.title: Salvage of a Penetrating Bilateral Testicular Gunshot Injury Using an Autologous Free Tunica Albuginea Graft from the Excised Contralateral Testis: A Case Report
pmc-13355627.creator: Anas Saad, Omar Al-Abed, Salem Hakouk, Mohammad Alaa Aldakak
pmc-13355627.description: BackgroundPenetrating scrotal trauma is an uncommon but potentially devastating urogenital injury. Testicular rupture requires prompt exploration, particularly when associated with urethral or corporal trauma. When primary closure of the tunica albuginea is not feasible, reconstructive alternatives may be needed to preserve viable testicular tissue.

pmc-13362764.title: Laser Processing of Fe-Cr-B Alloys: Microstructure Evolution, Non-Equilibrium Solidification and Wear–Corrosion Performance
pmc-13362764.creator: Lei He, Changle Zhang, Jiang Ju, Zhizu Zhang, Jintao Liu, Huajun Zhang
pmc-13362764.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Conclusions supported by direct bulk LAM (LPBF/DED) experimental evidence:Bulk laser additive manufacturing suppresses elemental segregation, reduces internal defects, and optimizes the balance between the hardness and toughness of Fe-Cr-B alloys.Optimized LPBF/DED processing enables Fe-Cr-B alloys to achieve relative density over 98% and remarkable boride refinement.

pmc-13381770.title: Physics-informed multi-task learning for permeability prediction and probabilistic HFU modeling: a case study from the Lower Bahariya Reservoir, Shahd SE field Egypt
pmc-13381770.creator: Khaled Saleh, Walid M. Mabrouk, Ahmed M. Metwally
pmc-13381770.description: Accurate permeability prediction is essential for reliable reservoir characterization and simulation, yet remains challenging due to complex nonlinear relationships and subsurface heterogeneity. Conventional hydraulic flow unit (HFU) methods rely on discrete rock typing and fixed porosity–permeability relationships, limiting their ability to capture continuous variations.

pmc-13399982.title: Brief report of core temperature patterns in triathletes while swimming in warm open water with and without a wetsuit
pmc-13399982.creator: Katsiaryna Afanasyeva, Alina P. Swafford, James W. Navalta, Graham R. McGinnis, John A. Mercer
pmc-13399982.description: This exploratory study investigated the effects of wetsuit use on core temperature patterns in triathletes in warm open water swimming (27.9–28.3°C). Methods: Participants (males (2), females (2), 49.5±7.8 years, body fat 16.3±5.56%) completed two 700-meter open water swims at self-selected submaximal paces: 1) wearing a full sleeve wetsuit (WS) and 2) no wetsuit (NWS).

pmc-13581848.title: Editorial: Robotic perception, multi-robot exploration, mapping, and autonomous computing
pmc-13581848.creator: Faiza Gul, Laith Abualigah, Rafal Szczepanski, Imran Mir
pmc-13581848.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ings that are dynamic, uncertain, and often resource-constrained, including agricultural facilities, offices, road networks, and healthcare infrastructures. This shift brings several closely related challenges. Robots must be able to perceive and map environments that change over time, coordinate efficiently with other robots during exploration, interpret human instructions expressed in natural language, and operate within organizational and regulatory contexts that may either enable or limit their deployment.
